items.summary: Add comprehensive console logging to BookCatalog component to debug why books are not displaying, including logging the raw catalog data from useGetBookCatalog, the filtered books array, the coverImages mapping object, and any errors during rendering

Verify that the backend getBookCatalog query is returning all 12 books (4 Thriller, 4 Romantic, 4 Ghost) with correct titles, authors, genres, and prices, and add backend logging if necessary to confirm data is being served

Check and fix the coverImages mapping in BookCatalog component to ensure all 12 book titles exactly match the keys in the mapping object, accounting for any case sensitivity or whitespace issues, and verify that all image paths point to existing files in frontend/public/assets/generated/
Add error boundary or fallback UI to BookCatalog component that displays a helpful error message if books fail to load, showing the user what went wrong and providing troubleshooting information

Ensure SampleBooks component is correctly using the useGetBookCatalog hook and rendering all 12 books without any filters or limitations, mapping book titles to cover images and displaying them in a grid layout
